label: EXPERIMENTAL / OOD
question: Does weighting past score-distribution errors by each fixture's pregame scoring pace and home-away balance improve the unique first and the ordered three in J1?
motivation: The fixed competition-wide shifts in R27 did not improve either score metric on the 312 date-held fixtures. The original recent R7 panel picked 1-1 first 99 times in 150 fixtures. Test whether the anchor's own expected total and win balance distinguish which exact-score errors persist among similar fixtures.

inputs.windows: Use the byte-locked R25 panel/fit archives and regular-phase dates. Train on the 2,291 pre-2025 fixtures, select on 218 fixtures in January–June 2025, then replay separately on 162 fixtures in July–December 2025 and 150 fixtures from January through November 21, 2026. The dated development windows have been used by previous studies.
inputs.history: Construct all R7 training anchors with complete date-grouped causal updates. Only training outcomes, original lines and the corresponding unfitted anchors enter the score correction. Use the same unfitted chronological anchors to calculate neighbor features on validation and evaluation. Apply the correction to the separately reconstructed, signed R7 grids on those dates.

method.features: Use the anchor's expected total goals and P(home win) minus P(away win). Weight each training fixture by exp(-0.5 times squared distance) from the query anchor, scaling the two inputs by 0.45 goals and 0.25 probability units respectively. Use only pregame features to compute weights. Use all training rows and do not renormalize weights to a constant effective sample size.
method.counts: Each team has buckets 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 or more. For each training fixture, one observed count goes to the bucket of the verified regulation score. Its expected vector is the R7 anchor's bucket probabilities conditional on the actual score's WDL and, when a valid original line exists, its exact Asian over settlement category. The actual result identifies a training label only and is never used to weight neighbors or project a query. Keep a second full-dose pooled comparator with weights of one on the same training fixtures.
method.calibration: For each query and each of the 36 buckets, multiply by clip((weighted observed + 8) / (weighted expected + 8), 2/3, 3/2). Round log multipliers to 12 decimal places before applying. Rescale separately within each WDL-by-Asian-over-settlement partition, or each WDL group if the original line is absent. This preserves WDL, each of the five applicable Asian settlement masses and the signed WDL and actual-line picks. Report the maximum partition discrepancy and kernel weight sums.

selection: Predeclare local mixture doses 0, 0.5 and 1. Zero retains the archived original ordered R7 scores. Require at least baseline first and ordered-three hit counts in validation, then select most first hits, most ordered-three hits, smallest exact-score log loss, and smallest dose. The pooled full-dose comparator is diagnostic only. After selection, report all fixed variants and the selected one on both chronological evaluation slices and their union. Compare same-fixture first, ordered three, WDL and actual-line settlement versus R7, market and the pooled control. Report hit and coverage counts, paired gained/lost, paired date-clustered 95% intervals, probability quality, changed picks, and which score ranks moved into or out of coverage.
forward: A positive selected dose with positive combined net first or ordered-three hits and no loss in the other is eligible for a new independent J1 pregame research comparison. Use the fixed training sample and dose, a genuinely prematch R7 grid and its pregame anchor, with original source times; pre-freeze the complete next eligible registered slate and three ranked research seats before the first actual kickoff. Rank by issued first cell probability then kickoff then fixture ID. Use existing official first displays only for formal stage scores, and require actual first-delivery proof, actual-line quotes and market coverage under the stage protocol. If the development screen fails, preserve the result as a historical diagnostic.
